'''Fizz Galko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] who worked as a bioengineer for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic War]], Fizz was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] where he developed [[Xenovirus Prime]] and planned on using it as part of an initiative against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to target specific Republic-allied sentient [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was responsible for administering the virus to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] most dangerous prisoners who were the intended carriers and vectors for spreading it to the Republic. He later tasked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] hero to detect infected aliens and mark their cells for further reference.
